_doc: Evidence-based overrides from burst_bruteforce.py (2026-08-16). Loaded by slim_run.py / run_segment.py by default (--no-burst-fixes disables) and put on the Segment by slim.apply_fixes; applied by slim.apply_burst_fix; recorded in calibration.json join.burst_fix and burst_map.json. 'lock' entries: a whole-segment lock for a sub-run tail too small for the coincidence arbiter (its bursts were paired one by one; the implied pulse_match offsets agree to the ms). 'bursts' entries (each keyed to its 'ntof_run', because a bunch number is meaningless without one -- every run numbers from 1, so a straddling sub-run would otherwise take the override in BOTH of its joins): per-burst bunch and/or DREAM flash re-reference for the LOW_COINC outliers (each scanned against every bunch within +-120 s at every lag within +-100 ms; the winner is the bunch whose wall+plastic candidates put >= 60 % of the burst's triggers inside +-25 ns after a per-burst (da,dk) line, the runner-up ~3 %). Scan records: ntof_processing/slim_pipeline/bruteforce_scans/.

lock.evidence: 14 of 17 real bursts (0-13) pair with bunches 655-668, the last bunches of 224581, frac25 78-99 %, runner-up 2-6 %, implied offset +41.129 s on all 14; bursts 14-16 fall after the run's last bunch (n_TOF off). Below the arbiter's 32-bunch / 150-count bootstrap floor, hence the lowered peak floor.
all 6 real bursts pair with bunches 3205-3210 (the run's tail), frac25 71-99 %, runner-up 2-4 %, implied offset +59.129 s on all 6; the other 15 clusters are 1-6 triggers (no beam).
